lines: Ollie Gordon II played 75% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 66% on the season, and averaged 18.3 carries.
He has scored 9.9 PPR points per game over that stretch, with 66.7 rushing yards and 16.0 receiving yards per game.
Miami is at Buffalo in Week 11 with an implied team total of 14.5 points, though Buffalo allows the 10th-most PPR points per game to RBs.
